name: avista-wp-performance
description: Diagnose and fix performance problems on Avista WordPress + Breakdance sites — a modular, diagnose-first, approval-gated toolkit. Read-only audit funnel (TTFB HIT vs MISS, infra ruling-out, cache warmth, access-log + php_slow analysis) pinpoints the bottleneck, then targeted skills act on it: a bot firewall + robots.txt to recover PHP workers from crawler overload, Breakdance Server-Timing profiling to name the hot templates/nodes, safe block-theme render micro-optimizations, and a slow-media-upload fix (Smush synchronous optimization + image-size sprawl). Every production change is backed up first, deployed only on explicit approval, verified before/after, and shipped with a one-line rollback.
